text: **A COLD START RESTORES THE EVENT LOG, and a log that is missing or unreadable is REPORTED rather than read as "this project has no history".** (vc 2026-08-16, on cc's defect at `a7aa0b9e`, which is fixed -- this criterion exists because nothing in the contract asked for the property.) **`ingest::resync` rebuilt seven tables from the extract and skipped the eighth.** Every other table is derived, so omitting one is recoverable; **`event_log` is derived from nothing (D34), so omitting it loses the data outright** -- the fact AC-03.9's ruling already names and no criterion required. **The reach was the whole cold-store path**: `load_fresh` warms an empty store through `resync`, and **an empty store is the normal state of every fresh clone**, because `intent/.cache/` is gitignored. So a clone answered every question correctly and had no history at all until somebody happened to run the explicit `intent sync --to-store`. **The second half is not a nicety and it is why this is one criterion rather than two: a missing log is INDISTINGUISHABLE from a project that has never recorded anything**, so the silent-success path is the default one and `IN-AG-NO-SILENT-001` is not satisfied by the restore alone. **Severity is set by hv's migration goal rather than by the bug**: every fleet member arrives at v3 as a fresh clone, so the cold path is the FIRST path a migrated project takes, not an edge case. **Contract-coverage finding worth recording beside the criterion, because it is the second one today: this defect and dc's 0038 both lived in territory no AC covered** -- the cold-store restore here, `.git/hooks` there -- and both were found by a node measuring something else. **The tests that mention `event_log` (AT-02.8, AT-04.5) were green before the defect and green after it**, so they were never wrong and never sensitive; the guard that caught it was a NEW test written for unrelated work.

state.reason: hv ruling D53, 2026-08-20: `intent/events.jsonl` is deleted and the event log lives in the store alone, so this criterion's subject is gone in both halves. There is no cold-start RESTORE because there is nothing on disk to restore from, and no MISSING-log report because a store with no history is now the ordinary state of a fresh clone rather than a defect. **THE COST THIS CRITERION EXISTED TO PREVENT IS NOW THE ACCEPTED COST**, stated in D53 and asserted in `openness.rs`: a clone arrives with no history, and that is the price hv took for deleting the tracked extract. WITHDRAWN RATHER THAN SATISFIED -- the restore path was real and worked, and it was removed rather than proved. Its replacement surface is AC-09.3, `intent events`, which reads the one home the log has.
